pause_test_scope: Synthetic DAG starts/waits and temporary local state; real PostgreSQL control queue. No live source collection.
cases: A separate pause process returns while driver.lock is held; the next stage is denied admission
The active game finishes all three DAG waits before pausing; the next game remains pending
A pause at the last game boundary is acknowledged; resume marks completion without repeating games
Pause during catalog or ranking stops before the next stage
Repeated run does not cancel pause or replace the saved session policy
Resume restores all/top/sample, catalog, date strategy, game/session budgets, hours and continue-on-drift
A duplicate resume neither starts another driver nor cancels an active pause
Unknown batches and scope changes are rejected without side effects
An active store failure remains failed despite a pause request
Progress distinguishes requested pause, acknowledged pause and a stopped driver
